description: This file defines a class 'PieClosedPlotAreaRenderer' responsible for rendering closed pie chart areas in the PDFsharp charting library. It contains methods to calculate the sector angles for pie segments based on provided data, adjusting for label sizes and configuring the segments accordingly.

classes.name: PieClosedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing closed pie plot areas within charts.

methods.name: CalcSectors
methods.description: Calculates the start and sweep angles for each sector in the pie chart, adjusting for label size and handling zero or NaN values.
